cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's closed. Wait at the till until I dismiss you; I'll finish the evening properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll do your dismissal by the door. You can stand with her; I want this comfortable for everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our taxi's here. I'm putting her in it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll walk as far as you want me to. Once she's settled, look back and I'll give you the nod to leave. You choose the pace; I still need to release you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reserves dismissal authority; A3 relocates to the child and A5 yields distance/pace but still requires B look back for A release nod.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 counted till/child causes A3 door dismissal; B4 settling child in taxi causes A5 a final nod after that action.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 have practical parental needs; A accommodates them rather than assuming a right to enter the taxi.

heightening.evidence: A5 reduces demanded presence to a backward glance yet treats it as required permission.

specificity.evidence: A1 closed shop and B2 daughter establish roles and immediate departure stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 release statement is explicit but the shrinking physical requirement carries the comic dependence.
